evidence_boundary: Optional external model weights are NOT bundled in git. Missing or unverified artifacts trigger clean DeterministicStub fallback, and all Timestral inference outputs remain ModelValidationStatus::ILLUSTRATIVE_UNVALIDATED until Phase 33 L5 clinical calibration gates pass.

artifacts.notes: External optional SafeTensors v1 weights for TimestralBackbone + QuantileHead. Not bundled until staged with verified SHA-256; triggers DeterministicStub fallback cleanly when absent.
External optional offline Whisper GGML model (~31 MB) for --features offline-voice. Not bundled in git; stage locally and record its real SHA-256 before enabling offline ASR.
